translation_direction: es → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Spanish electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Lázaro’s shrewd, dry, oral first-person voice is rendered in short clauses with natural connectives; Spanish syntactic calques were recast during revision.
decisions.rationale: The picaresque comedy lives in tone, not in word order.

decisions.decision: Proverbs and wordplay are rendered with an idiomatic Vietnamese turn that keeps the sense, without footnotes.
decisions.rationale: A reader should not need apparatus to follow the joke.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: A polarity inversion (‘no pareciendo ellas pudiera negar la demanda’) was corrected.
Three majors in units 117, 126 and 127 (mistranslated or garbled clauses) were corrected.
‘mi boca era medida’, ‘no sé qué, y sí sé qué’ and ‘canónigos’ were rendered into nonsense or the wrong office; corrected.
‘pringar’ rendered as resin and two opaque proverbs (units 12 and 39) were corrected.
Calqued Spanish syntax throughout was recast into idiomatic Vietnamese; the ‘hideputa’ insult and the ‘Commendador’ term were unified.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The unnamed addressee of Lázaro’s letter; one deferential pronoun through the book, with the irony of a man writing up shame as success.

glossary.source_term: el ciego / el clérigo / el escudero / el buldero
glossary.draft_rendering: gã mù / vị linh mục / ông escudero (quý tộc nghèo) / người bán giấy xá tội
glossary.rationale: Each master keeps one role name through his tratado.
The escudero’s theme word, rendered with a single term.
The papal indulgences the buldero sells.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #320, an electronic transcription of the Burgos 1554 edition of La vida de Lazarillo de Tormes y de sus fortunas y adversidades. The transcription’s editorial policy and orthography were not collated against the 1554 print.

unresolved_questions.explanation: A few idioms (for example the ‘cabeza de lobo’ line) are rendered by sense rather than image.

title_review.source_title: La vida de Lazarillo de Tormes y de sus fortunas y adversidades
title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title keeps the established name ‘Lazarillo de Tormes’; the Spanish long title is preserved in the source edition.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The prologue addressed to Vuestra Merced.
The closing bracketed promise of a continuation.
